title: Fractional $k$-positivity: a continuous refinement of the $k$-positive scale
summary: We introduce a real-parameter refinement of the classical integer hierarchies underlying Schmidt number, block-positivity, and $k$-positivity for maps between matrix algebras. Starting from a compact family of $α$-admissible unit vectors ($α\in[1,d]$), we define closed cones $\mathsf K_α$ of bipartite positive operators that interpolate strictly between successive Schmidt-number cones, together with their dual witness cones.
